blocks.title: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — reference flow in production
blocks.note: Each stage passes its output forward under a typed contract — schema, owner and freshness agreed in advance; the audit path shares the timeline with the data path.

blocks.x: Under the hood the pattern is a composition, not a monolith: 4 tower services, the Driisti Smart Vision Glasses platform for rails, and your estate at core systems for truth. Every boundary is a contract; every contract has an SLO and an owner.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)
Baseline measured and signed, the metric and owner named, the risk envelope agreed in writing.
Prove (6-10 weeks)
The pilot runs on real data with a control group — the gate review happens whether the news is good or not.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)
Hardening, enablement and scale-out in that order — no rollout faster than the evidence.
Compound (ongoing)
The next decisions enter the same loop — the backlog ranked by measured value per week of effort.

blocks.x: Day to day, the operating team sees one control surface: health, throughput, cost and policy violations for the workloads Driisti Smart Vision Glasses carries. Escalations arrive with the context attached — the runbook, the affected scope, the last passing evidence — instead of a raw alert and a hunch.

MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
